Net sales: critic raised a concrete objection: Wrong basis: You built FY2026Q2 net sales (47,502.2 USDm) by applying “comparable 1% + non‑comparable 3.861%” to the FY2025Q2 base of 45,300 USDm. Comparable (like‑for‑like) growth is not the required basis for net sales and is not simply additive to an assumed “non‑comparable” uplift. For Home Depot’s mature store base (net openings typically well under 1% YoY), a 3.861% non‑comparable contribution is not supported and effectively double‑counts growth. This makes the FY2026Q2 figure derived from comps rather than reported growth mechanics, i.e., on the wrong basis.
